title: Low-powered computers run faster, walking and standing still
items: On a low-powered computer, such as one with built-in graphics, the view is drawn softer while you move and a little softer when you stand still, and the sun's shadows refresh every other frame.
On a test computer of this class, walking went from about 10 to about 17 frames a second, and standing still from about 10 to about 17.
Photos you take are still made at full sharpness, and nobody in town is left out.
